title: Play dominoes
description: Play a dominoes session, review the result, and start another game.
guide: Ready for a strategy game → Dominoes → finish the session and review your result

title: Explore trade lessons
description: Browse a trade's lesson sequence and review completion and mastery-based unlock status.
guide: Ready to learn a trade → Trade lessons → open an available lesson

title: Practice a trade skill
description: Study a trade concept, complete guided and solo practice, experiment in a sandbox, and record a debrief.
guide: Need hands-on trade practice → Trade lesson → complete the solo challenge and review your next step

title: Find trade credentials and apprenticeships
description: Explore credential sponsors and apprenticeship locators and unlock practice questions through lesson completion.
guide: Ready for a credential pathway → Credentials & Apprenticeships → practice questions or contact a sponsor

title: View your trade skills transcript
description: View and print lesson-level training evidence and download an issued completion certificate when available.
guide: Need evidence of trade training → Skills Transcript → print your record or download your certificate

title: Create with AI tools
description: Generate, revise, save, and export projects with the selected AI tool.
guide: Need help creating a project → AI tool workspace → generate and save your work

title: Review an organization profile
description: Review an organization's grant opportunity package, partner-supplied Mirror data, and opportunity handoff history.
guide: Need an organization's funding context → organization profile → review or reconcile an opportunity handoff

title: Apply for benefits
description: Find state-specific application links, document checklists, local offices, and AI guidance for a benefit program.
guide: Found a benefit to apply for → application guide → gather documents and use the official application channel

title: Read a shared community brief
description: Read a shared community analysis with demographics, systems scores, modeled costs, and evidence limitations.
guide: Received a community brief → shared brief → review the evidence or analyze another community

title: Review case-management approach
description: Inspect the same demonstration risk-chain profile regardless of the route's ID parameter.
guide: Need a staff case-review example → Case-management demonstration → compare the resident view

title: Align with regional economic goals
description: Review a region's economic development strategy and compare a proposed program with its goals and performance measures.
guide: Need regional alignment for a proposal → CEDS Regional Alignment → review goals and assess program fit

title: View and print a certificate
description: View and print an account-linked certificate earned by completing curriculum module quizzes.
guide: Need proof of completed learning → certificate details → print the certificate

title: Review a classroom
description: Review a classroom's invite code, student roster, quiz scores, and lesson completion metrics.
guide: Need classroom learning progress → classroom details → review students or share the invite code

title: Complete a needs assessment
description: Complete clinical screening instruments and review needs-assessment results and recommended response urgency.
guide: Need to understand health and support needs → comprehensive needs assessment → review results with appropriate support

title: Build a community story pack
description: Assemble community data, matched grants, and an organization narrative into downloadable reports, presentations, and share links.
guide: Need a community evidence story → Community Story Pack → generate and review a shareable report

title: Read a curriculum document
description: Read a curriculum guide, lesson plan, or rubric with standards and attachments, with editing controls available.
guide: Need a teaching or learning document → Curriculum document → read attachments or open the linked module

title: Explore a curriculum level
description: Browse a level's modules and completion requirements and see personal progress when signed in.
guide: Ready for a curriculum level → Curriculum level → choose a module and work toward its requirements

title: Manage document signatures
description: Create, send, revoke, and track grant and partnership signature requests in the staff E-Sign Center.
guide: Need a grant or partnership signature → E-Sign Center → send a recipient an invite and track signing

title: Sign an invited document
description: Use an emailed document token to review a signature request and submit a drawn signature without signing in.
guide: Received a signature invitation → document signing page → review and sign the document

title: Review funded impact
description: Use a shared token to review attributed referrals and enrollment outcomes, filter dates, and export an impact report.
guide: Need results for your funded work → Review funded impact → filter and export the impact report

title: Check RFP compliance
description: Extract solicitation requirements, track compliance items, and audit proposal drafts in the admin workspace.
guide: Need reviewer-aligned compliance → Check RFP compliance → extract requirements and audit the draft

title: Review a household profile
description: Review household members, social needs, outcomes, and aggregate support measures for a selected household.
guide: Need household case context → household profile → review members, needs, and outcomes

title: Read an initiative
description: Read a published initiative's summary and full content and copy its share link.
guide: Need details about an initiative → initiative page → read or share it and return to all initiatives

title: Complete a lesson
description: Read a curriculum lesson and mark it complete to update your learning progress.
guide: Ready to learn a module topic → Lesson → read the content and mark it complete

title: Study a curriculum module
description: Review a module's lessons, activities, documents, and quiz and open the next learning activity.
guide: Need to continue a learning module → module details → open a lesson or take the quiz

title: Confirm a referral outcome
description: Use a referral-specific link to record whether the receiving organization enrolled or served the referred person.
guide: Received a referral confirmation link → outcome confirmation → record the enrollment outcome

title: View a Shared Partner Dashboard
description: View an organization's token-shared community indicators, statement of need, and benefits catalog.
guide: Need to review shared community evidence → Shared Partner Dashboard → inspect indicators or get your own dashboard

title: Take a module quiz
description: Answer module quiz questions and review your score, mastery result, and feedback.
guide: Ready to check your learning → Module Quiz → submit answers and review your mastery result

title: Resident Journey (demo)
description: Explore the resident-journey demonstration or a profile selected by the pid query parameter, while the path's id is unused.
guide: Need to understand coordinated support → resident journey demo → inspect how services and benefits connect

title: Review county workforce context
description: Review a Texas county's community indicators and gap diagnosis and open a local workforce support locator.
guide: Need county-specific workforce context → County workforce context → review the evidence and find local workforce support

title: Check referral status
description: Use a private referral link to see the receiving organization, current referral status, and recorded outcome.
guide: Need to know what happened to a referral → referral status → review its current status and outcome

title: Use a published studio tool
description: Purpose unclear from code: renders a manifest-defined public or organization tool with scoped fields and record actions.
guide: Need a published custom tool → studio runtime → review the tool and submit only the permitted fields

title: Explore a learning subject
description: Read a subject overview and choose one of its curriculum modules.
guide: Need learning in a specific subject → subject overview → choose a module

title: Verify a trade certificate
description: Verify a shared completion certificate and review its holder's training evidence and credential-preparation pathways.
guide: Need to confirm a learner's training → Trade Certificate Verification → inspect the certificate and training evidence

title: Contribute to a Community Voice project
description: Explore a project's map and community contributions, add a pin or reaction, and view its story.
guide: Need to share local knowledge → Contribute to a Community Voice project → add a contribution or read the community story

title: Moderate a Community Voice project
description: Moderate project pins, review safety flags, and update project visibility, access, and settings.
guide: Need to manage a listening project → Voice admin → review flags and update project settings

title: Review Community Voice insights
description: Generate AI themes from resident input, inspect sentiment, and synchronize reviewed insights to the public story.
guide: Need to synthesize community input → Voice insights → review themes and update the public story

title: Read a Community Voice story
description: Read a listening project's community themes and return to its map to contribute your voice.
guide: Need to hear what neighbors shared → Community Voice story → read the themes and add your voice on the map

title: Choose a workspace task
description: Browse tasks for a selected perspective and open available tools or sign in for restricted tasks.
guide: Need tasks suited to your perspective → workspace home → choose an available task
